_readme: Stations × providers × models. The only place a provider or model slug may appear; .py files never name one. A rate is a READING with a date and a source — where sources disagree both readings stay, and the ledger takes the reading that matches the tier/resolution it is asked for: an exact-resolution reading beats a later null-resolution one, and among equals the latest read wins. A null resolution on a reading means the source did not state one, so it matches any.
_registry: Slugs are each provider's own (Higgsfield job_set_type, fal endpoint ids). Pending fold-in to components/models/ as aliases — Dayu's gate, not done here.

_house.ruling: Damon: we have many providers and many models — streamline the models used so any tool, fal or Higgsfield, can do what's necessary. Approved families only: Google (Omni, Nano Banana) · ByteDance (Seedance, Seedream) · GPT Image · ElevenLabs. MiniMax and Kling retired. Role map: Seedream = stills/identity chaining · Nano Banana = editing/compositing real artifacts · GPT Image = photo-ref exact recreate · Seedance (+ Omni) = clips · ElevenLabs = voice.
_house.rule: one primary model per station per provider; a fallback only for a measured misfire (or a named, narrow use the primary cannot do); retired and superseded models are never deleted — their ceilings are knowledge, kept with a status of retired or alternate.
_house.ruling_2026_09_17: Damon, 2026-09-17, verbatim intent: GPT Image for ALL initial image generation from reference and for building the cast; discrete edits with nano_banana_pro; motion (the animation of an approved still) with seedance 2.5; talking/lip-sync ALSO on seedance — "we nailed it directly through Higgsfield and didn't use Cinema Studio at all"; voice = ElevenLabs; audio = the non-voice sound (the song for sung formats, music/effects otherwise — the editor's).
flags_2026_09_17: SUPERSEDES THE-CINEMA-LINE.md's 2026-09-12 ruling on the talking beat only ('never marry audio to video' → cinematic_studio_3_0 as the whole architecture). The 16 Sep run proved seedance_2_5 with the approved still as start_image and the ElevenLabs line attached as a media with role audio — the locked-voice rule held. Cinema Studio is now the talking FALLBACK if sync drifts, not the primary route. Everything else in THE-CINEMA-LINE.md (element injection, the receipts) still stands.

The audio station (seed_audio / ace-step) makes the SONG, and only for sung formats. There is no house call for anything else in that slot — music beds and sound effects are the editor's, per Damon 2026-09-17.
_house.principle_layer: The reference-level doctrine behind every pick in this file is `GENERATION-METHOD.md` (the reference carries the material; generate what must be photographic, composite what must be exact; never name the camera; judge by measurement, not taste). The course write-up (Damon, 09-14) corroborates the ruling and confirms the same model split: realism of a person → GPT Image; edits → Nano Banana Pro.
_house.ruling_2026_09_17_voice: Damon: voice is the direct ElevenLabs account, one custom voice per character — the line is generated first, from here, via the direct API, and the audio is piped into the provider (uploaded to Higgsfield as the media the talking beat lip-syncs to; on fal attached as the audio input); fal's own ElevenLabs endpoints see library voices only and cannot reach an account-private voice id (no key passthrough, no clone/design endpoint on fal — research confirmed).
_house.ruling_2026_09_17_song: Damon: song is Lyria 3 Pro on fal (fal-ai/lyria3/pro, $0.08/song, up to 3 min, sings written lyrics) so model usage stays on fal/Higgsfield; fal returns no lyric timings, so the timing sheet comes from one more fal call, fal-ai/elevenlabs/speech-to-text, on the finished song; Lyria via the Gemini API direct is the alternate (it returns timings natively); fal-ai/minimax-music/v2.6 is the alternate that sings lyrics with structure tags; fal-ai/ace-step is retired (lost the test).
_house.ruling_2026_09_18: ONE HAND. Every station is a direct call from run.py start — voice (ElevenLabs), cast/still (OpenAI), edit (Google), song (Google Lyria), talking AND silent motion (fal Omni via machine/omni.py). Nothing in the chain needs the Higgsfield MCP (Damon 15:20). Higgsfield and fal-as-a-house remain FORCED alternates only (--provider); BytePlus direct is wired and blocked on US billing; the Higgsfield API was declined. The editor sheet (SUBMIT.md) is written only when a house is forced.

credits_per_dollar._note: Ultra plan monthly $129 / 3,000 credits = 23 per $; annual $99 / 3,000 = 30 per $ (higgsfield.ai/pricing, read 2026-09-17). The 16 Sep receipts assumed 18 — every Higgsfield figure on The Road to $10 was ~1.5x too pessimistic.
